title: Design handoff contract (05-package/contract.json)
description: The machine-readable half of a design handoff package: what the page is, which concept block each component implements, the props a dev wires, the states that must be reachable, and the copy that must appear verbatim. handoff-check.mjs validates the package against this.

route.description: The route the page lives at, e.g. /business/residential-details.

archetype.description: The methodology §2 archetype this page composes.

blocks.description: One entry per concept block, same ids.

component.description: Component file name when the block is its own component.

file.description: Package-relative file the block is implemented in.

options.description: Where the option list comes from.

bind.description: The prop path the value binds to.

states.description: Every state the concept's data-states declared. Each must be reachable from a prop.

when.description: The prop expression that produces this state.

prop.description: The prop that drives it, when `when` is not a bare prop name.

kind.description: back | continue | confirm | card-advance | row | rail | utility — the methodology's action tier.

emits.description: The callback prop the host app receives.

record.description: Toast / activity-log record the methodology requires.

copy.description: Every copy string, verbatim. source=DRAFT means the architect wrote it under §8 and the reviewer approved it at the gate.

verbatimInMarkup.description: false when a type-* utility supplies the casing, so the markup carries the sentence-case form.

icons.description: Sprite symbol ids the page references, without the #.

planned.description: Every methodology §12 interim class used, so the dev team knows what to swap when the library ships the addition.
